notes: The repository-level main-protection ruleset is the canonical enforcement mechanism for main.
Mergify Merge Protections is not a required status check.
The repository-owned semgrep job is required so project-specific security rules are enforced before merge.

SonarQube Cloud remains enabled with GitHub App automatic analysis but is advisory rather than required because JS/TS coverage reports are unavailable under automatic analysis and provider check delivery can otherwise deadlock the protected branch.
Codecov is the blocking changed-code coverage authority.
The ruleset has no bypass actors and required status checks use strict/up-to-date enforcement.
